force_destroy.description: Only meaningful when `import = false`. When true, `terraform destroy` skips the delete action and removes the service record directly via `DELETE /service/{id}?force=true`. Use this as an escape hatch when the service is stuck (e.g. the create action failed). Note: Terraform's destroy reads this attribute from state, so you must run `terraform apply` with `force_destroy = true` *before* running `terraform destroy` for it to take effect. For tainted resources, run `terraform untaint` first so the apply is an update rather than a replace. Has no effect when `import = true`, where destroy already uses force.
